newsitem.title: USA: Reinsurance Group Q1 net drops after charge.
newsitem.headline: Reinsurance Group Q1 net drops after charge.

text.p: Reinsurance Group of America Inc said an after-tax charge to increase its reserves affected its net earnings in the first quarter ended March 31.
The life reinsurance provider reported net income of $2.9 million, or $0.16 a share, down from $10.5 million, or $0.62, in the same period a year ago.

The latest figure includes a charge of $10.4 million, or $0.60 a share, stemming in part from an unexpected reserve increase linked to estimated claims reported by one of its accident and health pool managers, Reinsurance Group said.
Revenues rose to $251.8 million from $200.4 million, while operating income increased to $12.9 million from $10.2 million, the company said.

Reinsurance Group also said it will continue to provide accident and health coverage directly to clients, but will no longer participate in insurance pools in which it cannot control the underwriting process. Such pools account for less than 10 percent of its premiums, the company said.
